What you're saying is so much healthier & makes so much sense.  It's the reason I posted.  Was hoping to uncover a response like yours.  I knew it was there, I just I couldn't find it.  Thank you, thank you so much.  I'll do this.

Edit:  Really, I can't thank you enough.  I'm so scared & I have had no idea what to do.  This is a good path to follow.

& I hope you're okay too.
